name: Roblox-inspired world
description: A bright blocky town in the sky with simple block characters; one huge yellow word at a time. Story and 'did you know' videos.
rules: Original block characters and worlds; never recreate Roblox characters or logos.
One word on screen at a time, big, yellow, black outline-like shadow.
Camera moves every shot: tilt up, drift, orbit; shots 1 to 2.5 s.
The world itself tells the story: scale, height, contrast between places.
camera_language: Dynamic: low-angle tilt-ups, orbit, drift; fov 36-60.
audio_direction: light bed, whoosh on every camera move, pop on reveals
pitfalls: Characters tiny in wide shots with nothing to see.
